issue.title: Template-area test failures on macOS CI (CaptureTemplate timeout, plain-newline and header-candidate assertions)
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked).

macOS CI on master shows template-area test failures that match no existing
task bead (bob-cli-7p covers the RefsPanelModel copy crash, bob-cli-7h covers
the RefsInspectorScrollTests paging assertions):

- Runs 38750465645, 38807458658, 38813536247:
  `CaptureTemplatePresentationTests.testTemplateRowNeedIsQuietAndUsesBobsDiagnostic`
  times out.
- Run 38819681612:
  `BobMacCaptureTests.testTemplatePlainNewlineInsertsOnlyNewline` fails and
  `CapturePanelModelTests.testTemplateHeaderCandidateReachableWithPrimedCache`
  fails.

The Refs failures in those same runs (RefsInspectorScrollTests hosted-short-content,
RefsPanelModelTests queued-digit copy) are already tracked by bob-cli-7h and
bob-cli-7p and were corroborated there, not here.

Reported via plan:202610/fix_mac_capture_install_build.md step 3. Root causes
are unknown; per that plan these were not investigated here.

## CI failure

- **Node:** `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureTemplatePresentationTests.swift::testTemplateRowNeedIsQuietAndUsesBobsDiagnostic`

The timeout repeated on three consecutive runs (38750465645, 38807458658,
38813536247), so it is a true failure, not a one-off flake. The two
38819681612 failures are single-observation and are recorded alongside because
they sit in the same template area, not because flakiness was ruled out for
them.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The CaptureTemplatePresentationTests timeout failed identically on three consecutive CI runs (38750465645, 38807458658, 38813536247), which rules out a one-off flake for that node. The two run-38819681612 failures are single-observation and kept in the same bead only because they sit in the same template area.
